method: Six blind readers, ~9 chunks each, fenced from cruces.md, the merge notes, the agent brief, data/plate-notes/ AND from grepping src/english/11613 at all (the answer key arrives through search results, not only through open).
note: 25 sites, ALL OURS, all fixed; zero Migne defects wrongly corrected — every reader rejected the Migne-side candidates (1159D bonum, 1200B ab Eva usque in Adam, 1218D salvaretur, 1248B Sponsus for Sponsa) as correct literal renderings. DOMINANT CLASS, 12 of 25: an unexpressed Latin subject or referent that English CANNOT leave unexpressed, supplied wrongly — the Bride given the Bridegroom's speech and vice versa, a demonstrative bound to the wrong antecedent, an accusative-subject indirect statement defaulted to the nearest nominative. Usually settled only by the NEIGHBOURING chunk, which is what a chunked fleet cannot see. Worst single site: 1206D/1207A rendered botrus cypri as Douay's 'cluster of cypress' against Foliot's own gloss two columns earlier that Cyprus is an ISLAND, collapsing his cluster-vines-wine chain. Also 1230D, where the [d:] dittography marker quarantined the wrong copy and inverted the argument (manifest->windows, hidden->lattices).
